    input(x)


     Jika x >= 0, mask = 0 (0x00000000)

    mask <- x bitwise_shift_right 31


     (x XOR mask) - mask
     Jika mask = 0: (x XOR 0) - 0 = x

    abs_x <- (x bitwise_xor mask) - mask

    output(abs_x)

endprogram

  begin
